## Lilith (CR 16)

**XP** 76,800  
LE Medium outsider (devil, evil, extraplanar, lawful)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., detect magic; Perception +28; **Aura** fear (20 ft., Will DC 29)  


**Defense**


**AC** 34, touch 25, flat-footed 30 (+1 dodge, +3 Dex, +9 natural, +11 profane)  
**hp** 255 (17d10+85); regeneration 10 (good, silver)  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +13, **Will** +16  
**DR** 15/good and silver; **Immune** fire, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10; **SR** 27  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., fly 60 ft. (good)  
**Melee** +2 axiomatic *unholy* longsword +25/+20/+15/+10 (1d8+7/19–20) or 2 claws +22 (1d6+5)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 20th)  

Constant—detect magic  
At will—animate dead, blasphemy (DC 28), charm monster (DC 25), fireball (DC 24), greater dispel magic, greater teleport (self plus 50 pounds of objects only), magic circle against good, mass hold monster (DC 30), see invisibility, suggestion (DC 24), unholy aura (DC 29)  
3/day—lightning bolt (DC 24), unholy blight (DC 25), wall of fire, summon (level 8, 2d4 erinyes, 1d6 lilins, or 1d4 barbed devils 100% or 1 pit fiend 40%)  
1/week—wish  


**Tactics**


Lilith begins combat by peppering her foes with her spell-like abilities. When combat begins, Lilith usually hits the closest opponents (she deems most susceptible) with her mass hold monster ability. Next she unleashes a fireball hoping to engulf as many opponents as possible. She then charges in with her longsword, peppering her foes with lightning bolt and fireballs. If she has time before battle begins, she uses her magic circle against good and her unholy aura on herself. Any foes slain in combat are subjected to her animate dead spell-like ability. Against powerful foes she summons other devils to fight with her.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 16, **Con** 21, **Int** 19, **Wis** 19, **Cha** 33  
**Base Atk** +17; **CMB** +22; **CMD** 47  
**Feats** Alertness, Combat Casting, Deceitful, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Persuasive, Quicken Spell-Like Ability (fireball), Weapon Focus (longsword), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +23, Bluff +35, Diplomacy +32, Disguise +35, Fly +27, Intimidate +35, Knowledge (planes) +24, Knowledge (religion) +24, Perception +28, Sense Motive +28  
**Languages** Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Infernal, Terran; telepathy 100 ft.  
**Gear** Amaheuris  


**Special Abilities**


**Fear Aura (Su)** A creature that successfully saves cannot be affected again by her fear aura for one day. Other devils are immune to the aura. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Unique Item: Amaheuris** Lilith carries *Amaheuris*, a unique +2 axiomatic *unholy* *longsword*.
